user.title: Genbu
user.description: Genbu gives your house one update point. One Genbu Show, the main update Show, looks for updates and asks about them; the other Shows follow the version it runs. Found Shows: {count}.

data_description.main_show: Leave it empty to pick later in select.genbu_main_update_show.

init.title: Genbu
init.description: {main} is the main update Show. Change it in select.genbu_main_update_show.

data_description.extra_mains: Most houses need one. With more, the house follows whichever of them runs the newest version.
data_description.notify_service: A notify service, like mobile_app_my_phone. It gets a push when a main update Show has been offline for a day.

second.title: A second main update Show?
second.description: {main} is already the main update Show. With two, the house follows whichever of them is newest. They cannot fight, but you get two Shows that ask about updates.

init.title: {name} is offline
init.description: Home Assistant has not seen {name} since {since}. The other Shows stay on their version until there is a main update Show again. If nobody answers, the house makes {pick} the main update Show on {pick_at}.

menu_options.pick: Pick a new main update Show

pick.title: New main update Show
pick.description: The house runs {house}. The recommended Show is online and closest to it.

abort.none_online: No Genbu Show is online right now. Try again when one is.

pick.title: New main update Show
pick.description: The house runs {house}. The recommended Show is online and closest to it.

abort.none_online: No Genbu Show is online right now. Try again when one is.

main_picked.title: {new} is now the main update Show

confirm.title: {new} is now the main update Show
confirm.description: {gone} was offline for 7 days and nobody answered, so the house made {new} the main update Show. The house version did not change. To change it, use {select}.

main_dropped.title: {gone} is no main update Show any more

confirm.title: {gone} is no main update Show any more
confirm.description: {gone} was offline for 7 days and nobody answered. The other main update Show carries on. To change it, use {select}.
